acceptance: Each item is fixed with a regression test in tests/unit/scripts/test_comment_policy.py, or explicitly listed as a known gap in docs/development/comment-policy.md
The strict comment-policy scan still reports 0 violations
description:
The independent soundness review of PR #2614 (commits 614a05fec..4ee3601f2) found no Critical or High issue and left these follow-ups:

1. Medium: tests/unit/scripts/test_comment_policy.py::test_reviewed_javascript_flows_still_occur skips when TypeScript is not installed, and the CI medium tier does not install it, so a stale REVIEWED_JAVASCRIPT_FLOWS entry goes unnoticed in CI. Run the check in the comment-policy job (which provisions TypeScript via scripts/run_comment_policy.py) or fail when CI is set.
2. Medium (pre-existing): a program piped to an unmodeled interpreter on stdin (`printf '...' | perl`, `echo '...' | ruby`) is not scanned. Report a bare interpreter reading stdin as needing an adapter, or list it under Known gaps in docs/development/comment-policy.md.
3. Low: PHP inline source with an HTML comment after `?>` is not flagged; add `<!--` to the php entry in UNMODELED_MARKERS (scripts/comment_payloads.py).
4. Low: bashlex AttributeError/TypeError now take the chunk fallback, which could hide an incompatible bashlex upgrade. Pin bashlex, or fail when chunk-fallback use jumps.
